newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Wintershall says producing 80,000 bpd oil in Libya.
newsitem.headline: Wintershall says producing 80,000 bpd oil in Libya.

text.p: Germany's Wintershall AG is producing over 80,000 barrels oil per day in its two concessions in Libya and production is likely to increase in future years, a company official said on Thursday.

"Today we operate five fields in the concessions 96 and 97 (in Libya) with a total production of 80,000 barrels of oil per day. Libya has become Wintershall's number one producing country," Uwe Koehler, managing director drilling and production told a gas seminar in Tunis.
"Due to good exploration results in these two concessions production is likely to increase in future years," he added.
He said that Wintershall, a wholly-owned subsidiary of BASF AG, was also active in exploration offshore Libya, where it holds a 25 percent interest in concession 137.

Koehler said that in Egypt where it has a producing interest in offshore fields in the Gulf of Suez, output totals 17,000 bpd, but the final phase of the fields' life was approaching after 22 years of production.
He said that the company also made three oil finds in Algeria but that they were not commercial.
"Algeria and Tunisia remain target areas for new upstream activities for Wintershall," he added.
